preconditions: A route and original mapped-lithology source records
requiredEvidence: Source identity and edition when available
Sample location when available; missing fields retained as unverified
decisionLogic: Match all vocabulary members in lithology fields; no geographic-name matching
Persist and reload the route input before selection
Verify canonical SHA-256 binding and reconstruct candidates and associations from original records
Apply compatible multi-member labels to existing rock-package roles; do not infer internal contacts from map-unit member lists
Retain other candidates with explicit unresolved-placement reasons
uncertainty: Mapped surface categories constrain rock candidates, not unique underground geometry or thickness
exclusions: Composite lithology list interpreted as observed vertical sequence
sourceStatus: Reuse of adopted vocabulary and mapped-surface evidence semantics; data binding is a project implementation choice
validationMethod: Roundtrip, multi-member/minority, stale-source/route/vocabulary, tampering, absent/malformed data, incompatible domains, synthetic-source separation, production-path tests
reopenCondition: New vocabulary or source format; newly supported geological architecture; source-specific internal contact evidence
